interpretation.gcl_spatial_specificity: Essentially absent. Only 2/6 diagonal entries are row maxima (sup_t, sup). Mean diagonal-minus-max-off = -0.007. The global mean Delta_rho = +0.020 is driven by these 2 sectors only; 4/6 sectors have off-diagonal max.
interpretation.gcl_biological_explanation: GCL/IPL is distributed broadly across all macular sectors with overlapping retinal ganglion cell dendritic fields. The macular GCL does not have sharp topographic boundaries matching the Garway-Heath disc-VF mapping. Global avg is therefore a more efficient GCL predictor than any sector.
interpretation.rnfl_spatial_specificity: Strong. q_i/q_s (hemifield) >> q_t/q_n (0.540 vs 0.164). RNFL fibers follow strict arcuate trajectories → disc sectors map cleanly to VF hemifields.
interpretation.paper_contribution: GCL average is the best GCL predictor (beta=0.480, global loss marker). RNFL q_i is the strongest overall (beta=0.555, hemifield-specific). GCL sectors add no diagnostic advantage over GCL average for VF prediction. RNFL hemifield split is the dominant spatial axis in glaucomatous structure-function loss.

problematic_sectors.gcl_sup_n: diag rank 4/6, off_max=vf_sup (Δ=-0.033). Inferotemporal VF worse than inferior central.
problematic_sectors.gcl_inf_n: diag rank 3/6, off_max=vf_inf (Δ=-0.013). Superotemporal GCL better predicts inferior VF.
problematic_sectors.gcl_inf: diag rank 3/6, tied with vf_inf_t (Δ=-0.005). Essentially no specificity.
